question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Feeling or showing extreme tiredness
solution:
The correct answer is '**Weary**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Weary**'.
 
• It means 'very tired, especially after you have been doing something for a long time'. [थका-माँदा (विशेषतः किसी काम को देर तक करते रहने के कारण)]
 
 
• *Example: He gave a **weary** smile.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Weary.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Vitalised**: give strength and energy to. (को शक्ति और ऊर्जा दें)
 
• **Nervous**: worried or afraid. (चिंतित या भयभीत)
 
• **Drowsy**: not completely awake. (उनींदु, निद्रालु)
